description: Place an order on a Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome market. Structured mode (apiKey, walletAddress=control address, sessionPrivateKey, outcomeId, one of coin/sideIndex/sideLabel, isBuy, size, and price unless isMarket) is validated against the live market first: side must belong to outcomeId, size is whole contracts, price in [0.00001, 0.99999] with max 5 decimals, size×price >= 11 quote (a full-position sell is exempt when managedAddress is given), market must not be expired/settled. isBuy=false sells side tokens you hold. reduceOnly is ignored by the backend. Returns status resting (with orderId) | filled | rejected. Pre-built mode: computedData alone.

accountRef.description: Connected account from gdex_connect. Supplies session key, wallet address, API key and session data so no secret is passed in chat

coin.description: Side coin "#<assetId>" from hl_outcomes sides[].coin. Give exactly one of coin / sideIndex / sideLabel.

computedData.description: Pre-built mode ONLY: encrypted payload. Must be sent alone (no structured fields).

isBuy.description: Structured mode: true buys side tokens; false sells held tokens

isMarket.description: Take the book at ±5% of top of book

managedAddress.description: Managed wallet; enables position-aware sell checks

sideIndex.description: Side index in sides[] (sides are NOT always Yes/No; read the labels)

sideLabel.description: Exact side label from sides[].label, e.g. "No" or a team name

walletAddress.description: Structured mode: CONTROL wallet address from sign-in (not the managed address)

name: hl_create_outcome_order
